name: How long does a typical multifamily remodeling project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical multifamily remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a multifamily remodeling project varies significantly based on the scope, number of units, and the specific types of renovations. A cosmetic refresh of a few units might take weeks, while a comprehensive overhaul of an entire complex, including structural changes or amenity additions, could extend to several months or even over a year. Factors like material availability, permit approvals, and the need to work around existing tenants also influence the timeline. A detailed project schedule will be provided after the initial assessment and design phase to give a clearer estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope, units, and renovation type, from weeks for minor updates to over a year for full complex overhauls. Factors like materials and permits impact the timeline.
